description_en: Queries the list of shared devices in a project
description_zh: 调用该接口查询项目的分享设备列表
name: QueryProjectShareDeviceList

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no Overview page or ID value is displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 指定每页返回数据的最大条数，取值范围：1~50，默认值为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en: The current page number. Pages start from page 1. Maximum value: 10000
parameters.help_zh: 当前页码，从1开始，最大为10000
parameters.name: page_id

parameters.help_en: The device name query condition. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 设备名称查询条件，模糊匹配
parameters.name: device_name
